CREATE TABLE "public"."lab_progress" (
  "account_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "account_type" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "hint_penalty" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "hints_revealed" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "lab_slug" character varying(60) NOT NULL,
  "score" int4,
  "started_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "state" jsonb DEFAULT ('{}'::jsonb) NOT NULL,
  "status" character varying(20) DEFAULT 'in_progress' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "lab_progress_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "account_type", "lab_slug"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_lab_progress_account_type_v1_bed3e337" CHECK (((account_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('learner'::character varying)::text, ('organisation'::character varying)::text, ('professionals'::character varying)::text]))),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_lab_progress_status_v1_d87d9043" CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('in_progress'::character varying)::text, ('completed'::character varying)::text])))
)
